item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Adeel looks at the diagram of a rectangular grid that is $7$ squares tall and $6$ squares wide. He wants the even-or-odd parity of the total number of small squares.

Which claim correctly decides that parity?

options.A: The total is even, because one side length is even.
options.B: Call the answer the label $7$, taking only the tall count.
options.C: Treat the parity as unknown until $7\times 6$ is fully multiplied out.
options.D: Say the even-or-odd decision is what creates the $7$-by-$6$ grid sizes.
